1st Vice Chair of the Board of Directors of the Canadian Ferry Association, a non-commercial organization in Ottawa, Ontario
 Compliance Order under Section 30
 WHEREAS you are appointed by the Governor General in Council as President and Chief Executive Officer of Marine Atlantic Inc.; 
WHEREAS pursuant to subsection 28 of the Conflict of Interest Act, I am required to review annually with you, as a reporting public office holder, the information contained in your confidential report and the measures taken to satisfy your obligations under the Act;
WHEREAS an email dated August 27, 2021 was sent to you asking that you return all necessary documents to complete your Annual Review to the Office within 30 days;
WHEREAS your Annual Review remains outstanding on the day of this Order;
AND WHEREAS pursuant to section 19 of the Conflict of Interest Act, compliance with the Act is a condition of a person's appointment or employment as a public office holder;
I THEREFORE ORDER YOU to submit to my Office within 10 days from the date of this order, all documents identified in the email dated August 27, 2021, all of which are required to complete your Annual Review.
